outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic diagram of breast anatomy and a classification table, not a plot requiring individual data points.
Panel B is a conceptual schematic illustrating the study aim, not a data plot.
Panel C is a schematic depicting the experimental method (luciferase recording setup), not a data plot.
Panel D shows illustrative line traces of circadian signals and analysis workflow boxes; line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel E is a correlation heatmap; heatmaps are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel F contains a schematic line plot of cell number over days for illustrative models; line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel G contains a schematic dose-response line plot; line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel H shows a gene expression heatmap and a mutation matrix; heatmaps are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel I shows PCA and 3D scatter plots where individual data points (cell line samples) are directly plotted as dots, satisfying the requirement inherently.
